$comment: Label manifest for Yolkster64/helios-platform, applied by scripts/github/apply-labels.ps1 (GET-diff-then-apply, dry-run by default, never deletes). The first sixteen entries are the labels the repository already carried on 2026-09-02, colors kept verbatim so a first run only fills the blank descriptions; the last five are three automation contracts (automerge -> .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml, copilot -> .github/workflows/copilot-dispatch.yml, dependencies -> .github/dependabot.yml) plus two reserved conventions with no consumer yet (hygiene, absorption-candidate). Names match case-insensitively; description is capped at 100 characters by GitHub.

labels.name: absorption
labels.description: Upstream absorption lane (docs/architecture/ABSORPTION_PIPELINE.md); never auto-merged

labels.name: ai-hub
labels.description: Multi-LLM hub: src/ai, config/aihub.json, the MCP server and the Python spoke

labels.name: audit-first
labels.description: Measure and record the live state before any mutation lands

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: build-ci
labels.description: Build, CI workflows and validation gates

labels.name: documentation

labels.description: Good for newcomers
